reading_rule: The surfaces overlap but do different jobs. Lean checks propositions; papers explain; Comparator checks selected statement/type parity and replay; Palomar is a separate editorial and registry review. No later surface widens the mathematical claim established by its source.

surfaces.authority_boundary: Papers explain the work and are not Lean proof authority.

surfaces.boundary: Using the degree-seven polynomial constructed by the erdosproblems.com contributor ani, Lean proves that every preconnected strict-lemniscate set containing two distinct roots has one-dimensional Hausdorff measure greater than two. This refutes the exact Formal Conjectures path-image-length statement; the separate total-variation bound is also checked. The other seven targets remain open. Independent human review of correspondence with the 1958 wording has not been recorded. Comparator checks only selected exact statements, axioms and kernel acceptance; it does not assess novelty or historical correspondence.
surfaces.review_status: self-assessed and agent-checked; no human mathematical peer review is claimed

surfaces.boundary: A prepared review unit is not a submission, Comparator verdict, Palomar review, registration, acceptance, endorsement, novelty assessment, peer review, or solution of an open problem.

release.entry_shape: one self-contained Challenge/Solution pair per entry
release.reading_rule: The release record does not include a dated awaiting-review count. Preparation alone does not establish submission or acceptance.
release.count_contract: Counts describe the recorded observation only. Outcomes can change; missing counts remain unknown and are not inferred from preparation.
